records.name: Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (IIMR)
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (IIM Ranchi), established in 2010, is a newer IIM offering PGDM, PGDM-HRM, and PhD programs with a distinctive focus on human resource management and tribal business studies reflecting its Jharkhand location. It has established itself as a quality management institution and is known for its specialized HR program, which along with its general management program provides strong placement outcomes. IIM Ranchi also emphasizes research on rural development and social entrepreneurship.

records.name: National Institute of Design (NID)
records.description: National Institute of Design (NID) Ahmedabad, established in 1961, is India's premier and most prestigious design institution, known for nurturing iconic Indian designers across product design, communication design, textile design, and digital media. It offers BDes and MDes programs and functions as a national body for design promotion, research, and policy. NID Ahmedabad is recognized globally as one of Asia's top design schools and has been instrumental in establishing design as a profession in India.

records.name: T.A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI)
records.description: T.A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI) Manipal, established in 1980, is a premier autonomous business school offering PGDM programs in general management, banking and financial services, marketing, and healthcare management. It is accredited by AACSB and consistently ranked among India's top 20 business schools, known for rigorous academics and strong industry interface. TAPMI is particularly recognized for its banking and financial services specialization and active industry partnerships in the BFSI sector.

records.name: Great Lakes Institute of Management
records.description: Great Lakes Institute of Management Chennai, established in 2004 with guidance from C.K. Prahalad, is a AACSB-accredited business school offering PGPM and PGDM programs. It is known for its one-year and two-year management programs with strong placements in banking, consulting, technology, and analytics sectors. Great Lakes has campuses in Chennai and Gurgaon and is recognized for bringing global management education standards to India.

records.name: IIM Nagpur
records.description: IIM Nagpur, established in 2015 as a newer IIM with mentorship from IIM Ahmedabad, offers PGDM and PhD programs with a focus on agribusiness and rural management reflecting its central Indian location. The institute is growing rapidly and its PGDM program has established strong placements in consulting, finance, and operations. IIM Nagpur benefits from IIMA mentorship and its strategic location in central India's commercial hub.

records.name: Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC)
records.description: Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC) New Delhi, established in 1965 under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, is India's premier institution for journalism and mass communication education. It offers postgraduate diploma programs in English journalism, Hindi journalism, advertising and public relations, and radio and television journalism, training hundreds of media professionals annually. IIMC has campuses in Dhenkanal, Aizawl, Amravati, Kottayam, and Jammu, and its alumni lead India's major newsrooms and media organizations.

records.name: Asian College of Journalism
records.description: Asian College of Journalism (ACJ) Chennai, established in 2000, is one of India's most respected journalism schools offering a postgraduate program in journalism. It is known for its rigorous reporting and writing training, strong visiting faculty from leading Indian and international newsrooms, and focus on digital journalism and data journalism. ACJ alumni work across India's and Asia's leading print, broadcast, and digital media organizations.

records.name: Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication
records.description: Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication (SIMC) Pune is a leading media school under Symbiosis International University offering MBA, MA, and BSc programs in media and communication. It is known for its practical training infrastructure including professional TV studios, radio stations, and digital media labs, preparing students for careers in broadcast journalism, advertising, public relations, and digital media. SIMC consistently ranks among India's top communication schools.

records.name: Xavier Institute of Communications
records.description: Xavier Institute of Communications (XIC) Mumbai, established in 1969 by the Jesuits, is one of India's oldest and most respected media and communication training institutes. It offers certificate and diploma programs in journalism, advertising, public relations, photography, corporate communications, and digital media. XIC's Mumbai location, strong industry network, and Jesuit teaching tradition have made it a preferred destination for aspiring media professionals.

records.name: AJK Mass Communication Research Centre JMI
records.description: AJK Mass Communication Research Centre (AJK MCRC) at Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, is one of India's most prominent mass communication schools, offering MA, MPhil, and PhD programs in mass communication. It is particularly known for its critical approach to media studies, strong emphasis on documentary filmmaking, and production-oriented curriculum. AJK MCRC alumni are active across journalism, filmmaking, television production, and media research.
